IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Financial Institutions & Insurance (originally sponsored by Representative Kagi)

Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying the heating oil pollution liability protection act.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the nature of coverage under the heating oilpollution liability protection act; and adding a new section to chapter70.149 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 70.149 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: An owner or operator who has registered a heating oil tank forcoverage with the pollution liability insurance program is not liablefor a release from that tank if a subsequent eligible owner or operatorfails to register that tank for coverage with the program, regardlessof whether failure to register is intentional.
